author: Noema I
title: RC-Augment (train-only) + DSConv (No-PE) with mean+LSE τ=0.5
abstract: Introduce train-time reverse-complement stochastic augmentation (p=0.5) around the unified DSConv+mean+LSE τ=0.5 backbone. No eval-time ensembling to keep runtime budget; aims to improve robustness without harming ncRNA/MRL.
